verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.

xrefs.text: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
“The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! He knows, and may Israel also know. If this was in rebellion or breach of faith against the LORD, do not spare us today.
The lion has roared— who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken— who will not prophesy?
You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them, O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts,

verses.text: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

xrefs.text: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm of Asaph. Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.”

verses.text: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.

xrefs.text: And fire came forth from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.
So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died in the presence of the LORD.
A river of fire was flowing, coming out from His presence. Thousands upon thousands attended Him, and myriads upon myriads stood before Him. The court was convened, and the books were opened.
His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

verses.text: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:

xrefs.text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
Listen, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for the LORD has spoken: “I have raised children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against Me.
Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing. Therefore choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,

I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.

verses.text: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

xrefs.text: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.

verses.text: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah

xrefs.text: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.
The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah

verses.text: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.

xrefs.text: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
“I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations— for the whole earth is Mine.
Therefore, I will contend with you again, declares the LORD, and I will bring a case against your children’s children.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,

verses.text: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.

xrefs.text: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

“What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.

verses.text: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,

xrefs.text: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

verses.text: for every beast of the forest is Mine— the cattle on a thousand hills.

xrefs.text: By My great power and outstretched arm, I made the earth and the men and beasts on the face of it, and I give it to whom I please.
He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
Wherever the sons of men or beasts of the field or birds of the air dwell, He has given them into your hand and has made you ruler over them all. You are that head of gold.
How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.

verses.text: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.

xrefs.text: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
And God said, “Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
Does the hawk take flight by your understanding and spread his wings toward the south?
Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!
Come, all you beasts of the field; eat greedily, all you beasts of the forest.

verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.

xrefs.text: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations— for the whole earth is Mine.
Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.
A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.

verses.text: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.

xrefs.text: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
If you make a vow to the LORD your God, do not be slow to keep it, because He will surely require it of you, and you will be guilty of sin.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?

verses.text: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”

xrefs.text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.

This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’”
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.

verses.text: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?

xrefs.text: Therefore the Lord said: “These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men.
The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

verses.text: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.

xrefs.text: But they were disobedient and rebelled against You; they flung Your law behind their backs. They killed Your prophets, who had admonished them to return to You. They committed terrible blasphemies.
Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.

verses.text: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.

xrefs.text: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.
Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

verses.text: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

xrefs.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
Each one betrays his friend; no one tells the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they wear themselves out committing iniquity.

But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.
Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.

verses.text: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.

xrefs.text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.

verses.text: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.

xrefs.text: Or do you disregard the riches of His kindness, tolerance, and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?
A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
For God will bring every deed into judgment, along with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.
Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lied and failed to remember Me or take this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear Me?

verses.text: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:

xrefs.text: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.

My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you as My priests. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number.

verses.text: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way, I will show the salvation of God.”

xrefs.text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
